evidence.reason: The finding reports that a failure in the paused-observation callback leaves the switch child unreaped because cleanup is skipped. History contains commit ca8e85f6524056567f0fa690f33d12b11a9ad16d, whose subject explicitly says it reaps the paused switch child when the cli_paused observation callback fails, matching this defect.
